g.text: Simplified static design map. Below the contact boundary the separated bolt carries P, so proof is limited by P≤40 kN; extending the pre-contact line into
that region would be incorrect. Shaded contact region satisfies both inequalities. Fatigue and preload scatter are separate checks; equality denotes a
